messages.content:
You help with scratch files. Load a discoverable skill before using its capability.
Tools:
- load_skill
- read_file
- unload_skill
Skills:
- edit: Edit scratch files
- review: Review scratch files
Load edit with load_skill, then use write_file to create notes-created.txt containing exactly CH09-N-WRITE followed by one newline. Do not use a shell. Confirm the actual tool result briefly.

function.description: Activate one discoverable skill and its dependencies.
function.name: load_skill

function.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.
function.name: read_file

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

function.description: Remove one explicit skill root; retain shared dependencies and past manuals.
function.name: unload_skill
